notes: Pure official-API Annex C.3 evidence for available-dimension union on one named object class and, independently, one named interaction class. Four adapter-owned schema-valid DIF modules supply two separate pairs. Each module is accepted alone, then its pair composes in Create Federation Execution. A joined member looks up both dimension handles and checks that the standard class-available-dimension query returns exactly their union. Native focused CTest passed 2/2; installed-package CTest and direct runner passed 8/8 each across both callback models; Java compiled against the API-only JAR. No region services are used. No conflicting-dimension, Java provider-runtime, interoperability, or conformance claim is made.
